'''David Destefanis''' won the [[2000 Rome Grand Slam]]<ref name="gs00" /> and the [[2000 Chandrila Regionals]].<ref name="dc00fin" /> He also finished fifth at the [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].<ref name="pc" />
